fields.description: Issue includes editorials and local reporting on a dispute over the Miami newspaper strike and press influence (referencing President Truman), criticism of Florida East Coast Railroad for failing to send condolences to the family of a maintenance worker killed while attempting a rescue, and a major argument urging municipal ownership/control of Miami’s electric utility franchise (Florida Power & Light) as a key civic issue. Additional coverage addresses proposed expansion of state railroad commission authority over municipal transit, complaints about diesel bus exhaust fumes as a public health hazard, notes on city/county tax exemptions and filings, flood-control needs in Florida, selected crime/court items, and entertainment listings and club advertisements in Greater Miami.
